title: Puthoff later briefs Grusch's group

tellings.quote: somewhere in that period they finally got to be meet with Hal put off and and he briefed them with his set of information

plain: At some point, the group working with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who later told Congress about hidden UFO programmes, finally got to meet Hal Puthoff, a physicist long involved in government UFO studies, and he briefed them "with his set of information." The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels this as something he knows from the people involved. If true, it would mean Puthoff fed what he knew into Grusch's case.
